title: KODAK PHARMACEUTICALS Expands Portfolio and Launches U.S. Online Store
summary: KODAK PHARMACEUTICALS expands its portfolio with Normal Saline, 0.9%, and launches a U.S. online store for pharmaceutical, biotech and life science…
body_markdown:
Eastman Kodak Company today announced the expansion of its KODAK PHARMACEUTICALS portfolio with the addition of KODAK® Normal Saline, 0.9%. The company also introduced a new U.S.-based online store designed to simplify purchasing for pharmaceutical, biotech, and life science customers.


This product addition builds on Kodak's growing portfolio of sterile, ready-to-use buffers and reagents manufactured in its U.S.-based, FDA-registered cGMP facility.


## Building a Core Portfolio of Essential Reagents


KODAK Normal Saline, 0.9% expands Kodak's portfolio into sterile reagents for laboratory and bioprocessing workflows. Manufactured and aseptically filled in the United States, the isotonic solution is fully traceable and USP-compliant where applicable. It supports Kodak's strategy to provide customers in regulated environments with consistent quality, transparent sourcing and a more reliable domestic supply.


## Introducing the KODAK PHARMACEUTICALS Online Store


In parallel with this product launch, Kodak is introducing a new online store for U.S. customers, enabling direct access to its growing portfolio of pharmaceutical-grade products. At[pharmastore.kodak.com](https://pharmastore.kodak.com/pharma/en/USD/) customers can browse Kodak’s portfolio of buffers and reagents, compare specifications, access supporting documentation and place orders.


## Building Momentum in Pharma


The addition of KODAK Normal Saline, 0.9% marks the next step in Kodak's phased expansion of its pharmaceutical portfolio, which includes Water for Injection and multiple PBS formulations, with additional products planned. Kodak is also progressing toward the introduction of Class II products as part of its broader strategy to expand its portfolio and support customers with reliable, domestically produced pharmaceutical solutions.


"The launch of KODAK Normal Saline, 0.9% and our new U.S. online store reflect our commitment to making essential pharmaceutical products more accessible to customers," said Jim Continenza, Executive Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Kodak. "By combining high-quality, domestically produced solutions with a simpler way to purchase them, we are creating a stronger foundation to serve pharmaceutical, biotech, and life science organizations."
